title: Desktop apps and tools
summary: RDP desktop access reuses the fixture display or restarts a session orphaned by sesman. The forwarded viewer trusts SSH host-key verification, bypasses the per-port RDP certificate cache, and retains reason-specific client diagnostics. Direct routes verify their certificates. Linux and WSL desktop provisioning requires --browser-project and --browser-identity naming the operator identity. It registers yoke-identity-browser.desktop, whose Exec runs yoke browser open through bash -lc, as the http, https and text/html handler in mimeapps.list, so desktop links open signed in. Verify refuses linux_desktop_default_browser_not_selected when links bypass that launcher. Provisioning no longer installs snap Chromium or sets x-www-browser. Live host proof is still owed.
